title: Pop Archive
label: STUDY 02 / SIGNAL DEPARTMENT
concept: Culture stays alive when somebody presses play.
intro: In a community archive, every tape is a tiny public square. Boom broadcasts the lost frequencies. Side B files the songs you almost forgot. Mix makes room between genres. Relay passes the signal to whoever needs it next.
influence: A nod to independent radio, mixtape sleeves, record-shop notices and fluorescent catalog systems. These are invented artifacts from an original neighborhood.

pieces.title: Keep the Signal
pieces.hook: A little noise. A lot of us.
pieces.narrative: Boom and Relay keep the archive open after closing time. The collection is useful only when someone takes it out.

pieces.title: Side B Is a Place
pieces.hook: Meet you on the other side.
pieces.narrative: Side B invites the neighborhood past the familiar hit. A record label becomes an address.

pieces.title: Play It Forward
pieces.hook: Good things should leave the shelf.
pieces.narrative: Mix and Relay turn a cassette into a bridge. Lending, listening and returning become a shared rhythm.

selectedCharacters.name: Boom
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Starts the room moving before anyone feels ready.
selectedCharacters.bio: The station's portable party host can make a soundcheck into a celebration. Boom's most popular broadcast is a mixtape made entirely of neighborhood noises.

selectedCharacters.name: Side B
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Finds the overlooked track worth coming back for.
selectedCharacters.bio: A late-night selector who always flips the tape. Side B collects stories about songs that were never hits but still changed someone's life.

selectedCharacters.name: Mix
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Brings different voices into a shared rhythm.
selectedCharacters.bio: A practical producer who keeps the studio kettle within reach. Mix thinks a good session ends with everybody wanting to come back.

selectedCharacters.name: Relay
selectedCharacters.oneLiner: Connects distant friends without stealing the spotlight.
selectedCharacters.bio: A rooftop signal watcher who thinks distance should make a story richer. Relay dreams of broadcasting a lullaby that arrives just as every listener needs it.
